scope: consumo item selection and optional label of unidentified ticket mesa; no payments/equal division change

create.expected_participants: Explicit integer 1..20 recorded as original_participants in existing mesa metadata. Omission retains historical default expected_participants=1 but original_participants=null. Client cannot set metadata/provenance.
create.restaurant_label: Optional string, <=400 raw UTF-16 units, no C0/DEL, NFC+trim+collapse whitespace, <=200 normalized units; blank equivalent to omitted. Only own private unknown fallback with no RFC/generic name; otherwise 409 restaurant_label_not_allowed. No restaurant mutation.
create.idempotency: Normalized nonempty label included in hash. Different N provenance conflicts for new rows, including omitted vs explicit1. Historical hashes unaffected when label omitted. Same key concurrent creation returns same mesa.

read.original_participants: Integer1..20 or null on POST /mesas, replay, GET /mesas/:code. Historical records without provenance stay null even if expected_participants>1. Never derive from participants_count/quantity.
read.restaurant_name: GET mesa detail/open/mine project the per-mesa label for unverified restaurant; verified restaurant name wins. Same access controls/audience as before. Client renders as text, never innerHTML.

lock.fraction_denominator: Strict numeric integer1..20, exclusive with fraction_bps. Consumo only; must be <=original_participants. Canonical requested bps = integer quotient 10000/n. Do not calculate cents client-side.
lock.known_original: Legacy bps requests must also be a unit fraction1/n for n<=N. item_ids remains whole. No bypass via old request format.
lock.unknown_original: Explicit denominators rejected409; legacy bps contract retained to preserve historical operation/claims. UI must not infer N or offer Otro without reliable original.
lock.preserved: Existing per-mesa/item locks, own claim replacement, availability, canonical residual absorption <100bps and integer cent pricing. Response claims[].fraction_bps is effective and may include residual. No rewrite of historical assignments. Equal and pay request schemas retain old fraction set.
